name: STRING protein-protein association networks

version.value: STRING v12.5 (file names of the download page)

scope: Scored protein-protein associations (physical and functional) for many species; the download page lists protein.links.v12.5.txt.gz (124.6 GB for the full network), protein.links.detailed (187.2 GB, with per-channel subscores), protein.info, protein.sequences and aliases, plus species-specific downloads. Open Targets integrates STRING: its 26.09 interaction dataset holds 13,205,373 STRING rows, 6,482,505 distinct gene pairs.
mapping_methods: Proteins are identified by STRING ids that combine the NCBI taxon and the Ensembl protein id; aliases map them to gene names.

quantitative.summary: Combined association score from channels (experiments, databases, text mining, co-expression, neighbourhood, fusion, co-occurrence).
quantitative.uncertainty: the score is a confidence, not a measured strength

licence.name: CC BY 4.0 as listed for STRING in the Open Targets data-source licence table; the STRING licence page itself was not read.

update_frequency: Major versions every one to two years.
coverage_limitations: A STRING link is an association (including text mining and co-expression), not necessarily a physical interaction
Scores are confidences and depend on channel weights
known_omissions: All files: the association scores reach the library through the Open Targets interaction dataset; the full-network files are far too large and the human-only files were not fetched

reuse_decision.rationale: Already integrated in Open Targets (13.2 million rows, 6.5 million distinct gene pairs), and the full network is 124.6 GB. A human-only file could be fetched later if channel subscores are needed.

status.notes: Download page read (file names and sizes); the licence page was not.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Associations from experiments, curated pathway databases, text mining, co-expression and genomic context, combined into one score; not tissue-specific.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: A mixture of curated, experimental and predicted evidence combined into a confidence; the channels differ greatly in reliability.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low. It places proteins in a network; it does not show that a variant affects a link.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A pair without a link has no combined evidence above the stored threshold; it is not shown to be unrelated.

overlaps_with_sources.note: Open Targets carries STRING associations as its string source; use one route and count each pair once
